title: Baked Sweet Potato Falafel
steps: Microwave sweet potatoes 5–8 minutes until cooked through, or bake at 200°C for 40–45 minutes.
Scoop flesh into a food processor with chickpeas, garlic, cumin, coriander, lemon juice and seasoning. Whizz until blended.
Line a sprayed baking tray with parchment. Shape mixture into small rounds; press down gently with a fork; sprinkle sesame seeds if using.
Bake 25 minutes until outsides are firm and bottoms crispy.
notes: Make spicy by adding ½ tsp chilli powder. Keeps in fridge up to 5 days, or freeze.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
